description: This file contains cryptographic big number (BIGNUM) modular exponentiation functions, including BN_mod_exp and its variants, used in cryptographic computations within the OpenSSL library.

methods.name: BN_mod_mul
methods.description: Performs modular multiplication of two BIGNUMs.

methods.name: BN_mod_exp
methods.description: Performs modular exponentiation, choosing different algorithms based on compile-time options.

methods.name: BN_mod_exp_recp
methods.description: Performs modular exponentiation using reciprocal multiplication method.

methods.name: BN_mod_exp_simple
methods.description: Performs simple modular exponentiation as fallback.
